newsitem.title: FRANCE: Danish finmin wants end to European tax havens.
newsitem.headline: Danish finmin wants end to European tax havens.

text.p: Danish Finance Minister Mogens Lykketoft called on Thursday for an end to tax havens within the European Union, saying the current situation was "unacceptable."

"I believe this situation is totally unacceptable. Within the European Union, we have fiscal havens like Luxembourg or those on which Great Britain relies," Lykketoft told a meeting of the France-Denmark Association in Paris.

"We cannot accept in the future the displacement of jobs due to inequalities in the fiscal regime of certain countries," he said when asked by a member of the audience what he thought of the great variation in tax burdens from state to state within the EU.

Lykketoft acknowledged that Denmark had extremely high taxes compared to many other countries, but said the Danes "obtain something valuable for the taxes they pay" in the form of health care, education and other social benefits.

He said that income from Danish taxes on electricity and water use and other taxes, imposed to discourage pollution and wasteful use of resources as well as to raise state revenues, would give Denmark some room to manoeuvre should it try to reduce income taxes.

He said he also backed cooperation between EU states so that no country was able to adopt fiscal policies that encouraged pollution in order to lure businesses and jobs away from another country. -- Paris newsroom +33 1 4221 5452
